title: PermissionInput
description: The fields that can be specified when creating or updating a content permission item.

principal_guid.description: The identifier of the principal (user or group).

role.description:
The level of access that the principal has been
given to this content item.

send_email.description:
Whether to send an email notification to the
principal being added. Only applies when creating
a new permission (`POST`); ignored on update
(`PUT`). Defaults to `false` when not provided.
